args.text: Analysis of L-tromino coloring: An L-tromino is formed by removing one square from a $2\times 2$ block. On a standard chessboard, any $2\times 2$ block contains 2 squares of one color and 2 squares of the other color (e.g., B, W; W, B). Removing any single square leaves an L-tromino composed of three squares. These three squares always consist of a mix of colors: either 2 of one color and 1 of the other, or 1 of one color and 2 of the other. Therefore, it is impossible for all three unit squares in an L-tromino to be of the same color.

args.code:
import math

N = 2025
N_squared = N * N

# Since N is odd, N^2 is odd.
# The number of squares B (black, corresponding to even i+j) is the majority color.
B = math.ceil(N_squared / 2)

print(f"N^2 = {N_squared}")
print(f"B = {B}")

# Check divisibility by 3
is_divisible_by_3 = (B % 3 == 0)
print(f"B is divisible by 3: {is_divisible_by_3}")
